bootstrap.mme: Recompute task Accuracy and paired-image Accuracy+ within each bootstrap; weight all questions in sampled clusters

qwen.numerical_status: Known Physical-Original / Dense-F difference; strict equivalence not claimed; evaluate exploratory quality only after semantic and resource gates
qwen.pre_gpu_gate: Actual Processor twice on every image; actual merged tokens <=2048; model-specific input/Smoke freeze in qwen_gpu_protocol.json

seed_bench.aggregation: FP32 mean negative conditional log probability of candidate content
seed_bench.answer_steps: first candidate token predicted at P-1; every later candidate token uses actual incremental Decode
seed_bench.cache_fork: independent deepcopy of immutable prompt cache; strict equality to cold complete option requests required in Smoke
seed_bench.llava_candidate_suffix: one native assistant separator space + complete choice text + </s>
seed_bench.primary_metric: Accuracy percent; option with minimum mean candidate NLL is predicted
seed_bench.protocol_adaptation: Native HF chat template and frozen historical Processor retained. Official mean-NLL ranking is ported; published scores may use another conversation template/preprocessing and are not directly interchangeable.
seed_bench.qwen_candidate_suffix: complete choice content only, model-specific official Qwen interface convention
seed_bench.unique_key: original annotation record index; duplicate upstream IDs retained

smoke_memory_gate: Peak reserved <= total GPU memory -512MiB; no budget/backend fallback
